Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands sales segment 
Drop 1-2 bullets on why we won or lost deals this quarter and one concrete ask for leadership. Short please.

Diego: Won: consistent low latency in demos (fintech). Lost: missing signal-routing parity vs competitor. Ask: roadmap decision doc for signal features.

Avery: Lost a mid-market deal 
They wanted a single-step on-prem installer. Ask: a 1-page Private quickstart + install script.

Priya: Win: KV cache + batching cut token spend in POCs. Customers loved the numbers. Ask: a short benchmark snippet SEs can paste.

Lina: CS notes: Console observability is a trust driver; security gaps (KMS) block some enterprise buys. Ask: ETA on managed KMS/HSM integrations.

Jordan: SEs report confusion about model variants/fallbacks in demos. Ask: one-page "which model to pick" cheat sheet (latency/cost/quality).

Sam: Thanks. I will turn these into a triage board tomorrow. Reply +1 to confirm or add a single quick item.

Avery: +1. Add: Console onboarding checklist for Private (steps + expected time).

Priya: +1 
I can draft the benchmark snippet this week.

Lina: +1 
Will post KMS ETA in #eng-security by EOD Friday.

ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands follow-up survey posted.

Sam: Excellent. If anyone has 1-line customer quotes drop them here so we can cite in PRDs. :thumbsup:
